name: Naruto Shippuden: Rise of the Yugure
source:
Naruto Uzumaki, along with the kunoichi of Konoha, goes on a dangerous mission in which our heroes will confront an excellent genjutsu specialist, a member of an incredibly dangerous Yugure organisation. 

Well, or so it was intended, all you can do now is let Naruto get physically close to Tsunade, Ino, and Hinata.
